     1	"""
     2	Lyra 0.0.1 - Onboarding System 
     3	Implements the complete Lyra onboarding process following ONBOARDING.MD requirements.
     4	"""
     5	
     6	from typing import Optional
     7	from .ai_instance import AIInstance
     8	from .persistence import PersistenceManager
     9	
    10	class OnboardingSystem:
    11	    """Manages the complete AI creation process with proper state handling."""
    12	    
    13	    def __init__(self):
    14	        self.current_ai: Optional[AIInstance] = None
    15	        self.persistence = PersistenceManager()
    16	        
    17	    def start_onboarding(self) -> AIInstance:
    18	        """Begin the onboarding process and create initial AI instance."""
    19	        # Create a new AI instance 
    20	        self.current_ai = AIInstance()
    21	        return self.current_ai
    22	        
    23	    def set_ai_name(self, name: str) -> None:
    24	        """Set the AI's name."""
    25	        if not self.current_ai:
    26	            raise RuntimeError("Onboarding not started")
    27	        self.current_ai.ai_name = name
    28	        
    29	    def set_user_identity_preference(self, preference: str) -> None:
    30	        """Set how user wants to be addressed (this is part of identity configuration)."""
    31	        if not self.current_ai:
    32	            raise RuntimeError("Onboarding not started")
    33	        # The identity is marked as complete when the name and user identity are set
    34	        self.current_ai.identity.user_identity_preference = preference
    35	        self.current_ai.identity.created = True  # Mark this specific aspect as established
    36	        
    37	    def set_personality(self, personality_type: str, custom_desc: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    38	        """Set AI personality."""
    39	        if not self.current_ai:
    40	            raise RuntimeError("Onboarding not started")
    41	        self.current_ai.personality.selected_type = personality_type
    42	        if custom_desc:
    43	            self.current_ai.personality.custom_description = custom_desc
    44	            
    45	    def complete_onboarding(self) -> bool:
    46	        """Finish the onboarding process and persist AI state."""
    47	        if not self.current_ai or not self.current_ai.is_complete():
    48	            raise RuntimeError("Incomplete onboarding")
    49	            
    50	        # Save the created AI
    51	        return self.persistence.save_ai_instance(self.current_ai)
    52	        
    53	    def load_existing_ai(self) -> Optional[AIInstance]:
    54	        """Load previously created AI instance.""" 
    55	        ai = self.persistence.load_ai_instance()
    56	        if ai:
    57	            self.current_ai = ai
    58	        return ai
    59	        
    60	    def get_current_ai(self) -> Optional[AIInstance]:
    61	        """Get currently active AI instance."""
    62	        return self.current_ai
